articles.title: Look up! Northern lights possible tonight 'as far south as Alabama'
articles.mainIdea: Look up! Northern lights possible tonight 'as far south as Alabama'
articles.summary: USA TODAY: Look up! Northern lights possible tonight 'as far south as Alabama'. A geomagnetic storm expected to hit the Northern Hemisphere overnight will increase the possibility of the aurora borealis being visible "as far south as Alabama to northern California."
